text:
Sam: Hey — heads up, noticed evalping reminders routed to hiring managers instead of interviewers for a few IC roles. got 3 escalations this morning.
Olivia: omg saw that too, got pinged for 2 candidates i didn't interview. :grimacing:
Priya: same, my hiring manager got 3 evals in their inbox. looks like owner field mapping changed?
Jin: jumping in — is this the webhook that maps `owner_email` -> `assignee` in the ATS integration?
Sam: not sure, but screenshots show `assignee_type: hiring_manager` where it used to be `interviewer`. filing ticket now: RECR-4821.
Nora: recruiter-bot just posted a delivery failure for RECR-4821: "routing-rule mismatch: rule_id=eval-owner-v2"
recruiter-bot: [automated] detected 14 eval reminders with unexpected assignee type in last 30m, sample payload attached.
Sam: attaching sample payload from the bot:
```
{
  "candidate_id": "C-4482",
  "job": "SWE-2",
  "reminder_type": "evalping",
  "owner_email": "ana+hiring@company.com",
  "owner_role": "hiring_manager",
  "expected_role": "interviewer"
}
```
Olivia: that `owner_email` normalization function changed in the ATS webhook deploy yesterday, right?
Priya: yes, ops merged a small refactor to owner lookup (PR #3428) that collapsed `interviewer`/`hm` buckets.
Jin: ok repro steps: call the webhook with `owner_role: interviewer` and see what the routing service stores. i can test on staging.
Sam: priorities: 1) stop prod reminders going to HMs, 2) identify window/volume, 3) revert or hotfix.
Nora: temporary mitigation: disabled evalping producer for jobs with role prefix `SWE` at 10:12 UTC. should reduce noise.
Priya: thanks — can we also add a quick alert rule to detect if >5% of evals go to hiring_manager in 10m?
Jin: will add detection to monitoring (oncall pager if >20 in 5m).
recruiter-bot: [automated] disabled topic `evalping-prod` (by Nora) — queued messages will be backfilled when enabled.
Sam: Jin, can you do a rollback of PR #3428 to restore original owner mapping today? If not, a targeted hotfix that enforces `assignee = interviewer if expected_role == 'interviewer'` is fine.
Jin: I can patch and deploy a hotfix to routing service within the hour. prepping patch now.
Olivia: please also post a quick note in the interviewers handbook channel + ping folks who were incorrectly CC'd. some HMs already replied asking why they got alerts.
Priya: i'll draft a short message and tag hiring leads.
Sam: estimate the blast window — recruiter-bot said 14 misrouted notifications; need to check DB for historical impact.
Nora: db query started: SELECT count(*) FROM reminders WHERE created_ts BETWEEN 2167886400 AND 2167890000 AND assignee_type='hiring_manager' AND reminder_type='evalping';
Jin: patch deployed at 10:45 UTC, routing now enforces expected_role mapping.
Sam: confirmed — just received a success telem: assignee_type is `interviewer` again. :tada:
Olivia: nice work, thanks team.
Priya: i'll follow up with a short postmortem doc in /handbook/ops/recruiting and link to RECR-4821.
Nora: recruiter-bot will reopen backfill and retry queue once we say `resume`. leaving it paused for now.
Sam: final checklist before closing thread: 1) monitoring alert added (Jin) 2) postmortem + comms (Priya) 3) confirm backfill without duplicate pings (Nora) 4) link to PR revert/hotfix (Jin).
Jin: all set, added alert and PR links to ticket.
Priya: posting comms now.
Nora: recruiter-bot will resume backfill at 11:30 UTC (manual) after we confirm de-dupe logic.
Sam: closing for now, will reopen if anything else shows up. thanks everyone. :heart:
